blurb: Guests enjoy private charters on a 33-foot Grady White boat with options including full-day, half-day, sunset, morning, and fishing trips. Activities include swimming, tubing, rock jumping, exploring coves, and scenic cruising around Newport Harbor and beyond. Catering options from local restaurants are available for onboard dining.

quotes.author: Hannah C.
quotes.text: Celebrated a 30th with Newport Boat Adventures and it was a perfect evening! So easy to book, and quick communication with any questions I had. I will definitely book again before the summer ends — absolutely recommend to anyone looking for a great time away from the busy streets of Newport.

quotes.author: Alexa C.
quotes.text: So nice to have a boat to yourself around Newport. Nick was great — super fun to have as your captain. He let my friend's son sit with him the entire time and answered all of his questions. Such a fun experience! Can't wait to do it again!

quotes.author: Rachel S.
quotes.text: Me and my family went out on the waters with Captain Nick and had an AWESOME experience! Beautiful views — he took us to cool cliff diving spots and even a bridge jump! So fun. A must for a Newport visit!

quotes.author: Andy F.
quotes.text: The captain and crew are knowledgeable of the area with great conversation skills. They navigated the waters with a safety-first mindset and I appreciated that! I can't wait to book again next summer!

quotes.author: Nana A.
quotes.text: My girlfriend and I had a wonderful time with Captain Nik. Very memorable day. The service and boat ride was 10/10. Great views and great prices — highly recommend for a boat experience in Newport!

quotes.author: Maura G.
quotes.text: Great day on the boat with Nik! He let us decide what we wanted to do, and let us go tubing off the back of the boat! He was super fun and easy to talk to. We will book again next time in Newport.

quotes.author: Sophie G.
quotes.text: We had a great day out on the water. Nik picked a perfect spot for a boat picnic and took us tubing — super fun. We saw some amazing sailboats too. Would definitely love to do it again!

quotes.author: Beverly G.
quotes.text: Fabulous time — this added a great memory for myself and my niece while she was here in RI for a visit! Highly recommend for a safe, fun, affordable experience. Wonderful in every way!
